messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert inc-5234 — sustained 5xx spike on /v1/generate (canary us-west-2 pool) for ~90s. Pager routed to @oncall-ml
ana: paging @oncall-ml — canary traffic showing errors, customers might see degraded responses. grabbing dashboards now
oncall-ml: on it. 5xx ~7%, p95 latency up. Did rollout increase canary traffic ~5m ago?
jamie: yes, deploying model v2.3-canary at 12% traffic at ~11:04 UTC
sam: weird — automation should auto-rollback at 5% 5xx over 1m per runbook. looks like it didn't fire
oncall-ml: checking controller logs for auto-rollback hook, running:
```
kubectl logs deploy/rollout-controller -n infra | grep "auto-rollback"
```
luisa: quick mitigation idea: flip feature flag `model_v2_canary` -> 0% to stop routing. @ana can you toggle?
ana: flipping flag now -> toggled `model_v2_canary=false` :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: change recorded: featureflag-service updated model_v2_canary=false by ana
jamie: traffic shifting off, but seeing residual errors (~3%) from warm pods still terminating
oncall-ml: initiating manual rollback to previous RS:
```
kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference -n prod --to-revision=102
```
sam: rollback started, CI rollback job running
oncall-ml: once rollback completes, run smoke check:
```
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate | jq '.status'
```
ana: rollback finished. smoke passed on canary-1 and canary-2. p95 back near baseline
luisa: customer impact: Support logged 4 customers with transient 502s between 11:03-11:12 UTC. No data loss reported. CSM looped for outreach
jamie: TL;DR for PMs: automated rollback failed to trigger, mitigated by flag flip + manual rollback. Need to root cause controller webhook auth and add extra guard in runbook
oncall-ml: handing off to eng-sre for postmortem and infra fix. @sam can you own follow-up?
sam: taking ownership. will add postmortem, create ticket to add webhook perms check and an automated fallback path
ana: handing off to next oncall in 30m. monitoring for 30m then close incident. :coffee:
incident-bot: incident inc-5234 resolved by manual rollback + flag flip. Duration ~22m. Pager closed.
